name.zh: Winfrenatia 化石叶状体教学片段

author: Leon Made This / s010s

description.en: One enlarged fossil-thallus teaching fragment with debated affinity; retains the2009 cyanobacterial interpretation, not settled Zygomycota or a modern partnership. Layout/count/depth/underside/nominal80x50x4mm dimensions are authored; microscopic nets and bodies omitted.
description.zh: 放大的化石叶状体教学片段，亲缘解释有争议并保留2009年蓝细菌解释；不宣称确定接合菌类或现代共生组合。约80×50×4毫米为展示尺度，省略微观网状体和小体。
